subject: Planning: Global demo — avoiding regional holidays / split-session proposal
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>, Suresh Patel <suresh@fintechindia.com>, Yuko Tanaka <y.tanaka@tokyotech.co.jp>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed times for global demo (May window)

Hi Alex / Suresh / Yuko —

Thanks again for the interest — great to hear all three teams want to join. I wanted to propose a few options for the full product demo so we can lock something that works for US / EU / APAC. Attached is a short agenda and an .ics with candidate slots.

Quick notes:
- Goal: 45-minute demo + 15 min Q&A (60 total)
- Suggested windows (all shown in UTC / local):
  • Tue May 4, 15:00 UTC (08:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 00:00 JST next day)
  • Wed May 5, 10:00 UTC (03:00 PT / 11:00 CET / 19:00 JST)
  • Thu May 6, 18:00 UTC (11:00 PT / 19:00 CET / 02:00 JST next day)

If any of these look reasonable I’ll send a calendar invite and record for anyone who can’t make it. I included the draft agenda (Demo-Agenda-v3.docx) and a proposed-times.ics so you can try to add the slots.

Thanks — happy to adjust after hearing who will be attending from each org.

—Monica
Monica Patel | Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Yuko Tanaka <y.tanaka@tokyotech.co.jp>

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 02:43:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Proposed times for global demo (May window)

Thanks Monica — we appreciate the options. Quick heads up from Tokyo: Golden Week means several engineers will be OOO from Apr 29–May 5, so the May 4 and May 5 slots look risky.

Could we avoid the first week of May? If not possible, we can join a recorded session but prefer a live APAC window later in May.

Also, we usually prefer sessions that finish by 19:30 JST for our engineering leads.

Best,
Yuko
Yuko Tanaka | Head of Integrations, TokyoTech
From: Suresh Patel <suresh@fintechindia.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>, Yuko Tanaka <y.tanaka@tokyotech.co.jp>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 11:05:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Proposed times for global demo (May window)

Appreciate the options, Monica. For India: Diwali is mid-November this year and we will have a few people OOO around that time — but May is fine for us. That said, if APAC is blocked in early May due to Golden Week, maybe we should plan two shorter sessions (one APAC-friendly, one US/EU-friendly) rather than forcing one slot that leaves key folks out.

If it helps, we can recommend Nov 22–30 for a follow-up deep-dive where our regional product team will be available after Diwali.

Cheers,
Suresh
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposed times for global demo — APAC Golden Week conflict

Hey team — forwarding replies from Tokyo and India. Summary:
- Tokyo: Golden Week (Apr 29–May 5) — avoid early May live slots
- India: May is OK, but they flagged Diwali (mid-Nov) for future deep-dives
- Ask: Do we (A) push to late May for one session, (B) split into two shorter sessions (APAC + US/EU), or (C) run a single EU/US live + record APAC?

Thoughts: my preference is (B) — two 45-minute focused sessions ensures all regions have core folks live; we can record both and combine notes. That also gives us a chance to tailor the demo to regional use cases (latency/caching/edge routing).

Proposed split (quick):
- APAC-focused: Tue May 18, 2026 07:00 PDT / 14:00 UTC / 23:00 JST (45m) — earlier APAC-friendly time window
- EU/US-focused: Wed May 19, 2026 18:00 UTC / 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET (45m)

If you agree I’ll propose invites with two calendar events and a short shared doc for region-specific asks.

—Monica

Subject: Re: Proposed times for global demo — APAC Golden Week conflict

Thanks for the notes, Monica and team. Splitting into two shorter sessions sounds perfect — our EU engineering partners will join the EU/US slot, and our APAC PMs will try to make the APAC-focused session (if timing works).

Couple of asks:
- Can we confirm sessions are recorded and that we’ll share slides + a short transcript? (helps internal folks in different timezones)
- Can you include a short checklist in the invite about browser compatibility and corporate firewall ports (we’ve had participants behind stringent corporate proxies before)?

If that works, we’re good with the May 18 / May 19 plan — please send invites.

Best,
Alex

Subject: Re: Planning: Global demo — avoiding regional holidays / split-session proposal (final schedule)

Hi all — looping back after regional availability checks and the Diwali period that Suresh mentioned earlier. We decided to move the APAC-focused deep-dive to the post-Diwali window so Suresh’s product team can join live. Final schedule below and calendar invites are attached (split-session-plan.pdf includes invite links and a combined agenda):

Final plan:
- APAC deep-dive (short, focused): Mon Nov 23, 2026 06:30 PT / 14:30 UTC / 23:30 JST — 45 minutes, recorded
- EU/US full demo + Q&A: Tue Nov 24, 2026 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET — 60 minutes, recorded

Notes:
- We confirmed recordings + transcript and will upload slides to the shared Drive link after each session.
- Firewall/browser checklist included in each invite description.
- If any time is still problematic, we’ll offer a short office-hours slot the following week to catch missing stakeholders.

Thanks for your patience — looking forward to the sessions. I’ve attached the final split-session-plan.pdf and the updated invites.

—Monica
